__table__: Stores customer order transactions and fulfillment details to support sales reporting, revenue analysis, and logistics performance tracking.
carrier: Holds the name of the shipping service provider, used to evaluate carrier efficiency, transit times, and delivery reliability.
client_id: Holds the unique identifier of the customer placing the order, used to analyze customer retention, purchase frequency, and client lifetime value.
delivery_date: Holds the date the shipment arrived at the destination, used to calculate fulfillment lead times and monitor on-time delivery performance.
destination_city: Holds the recipient city and state or country code, used to map geographic demand concentration and optimize delivery routing.
is_promo: Holds a flag indicating whether the order received a promotional discount, used to evaluate marketing campaign participation and promo-driven volume.
order_date: Holds the date the order was created, used for sales trend analysis, cohort tracking, and seasonality studies.
order_id: Holds the unique identifier for each order transaction, used to track distinct purchases and aggregate order-level metrics.
order_value_usd: Holds the total monetary amount for the order line in US dollars, used as the core metric for financial reporting and total revenue analysis.
origin_city: Holds the departure city and state or country code of the shipment, used to map outbound distribution corridors and logistics flow.
product_category: Holds the classification group of the purchased item, used to analyze sales mix and category-level revenue contributions.
promo_discount_pct: Holds the discount percentage applied to the order, used to assess the depth of price promotions and analyze margin impact.
quantity: Holds the count of units ordered, used to measure sales volume, demand intensity, and average basket size.
region: Holds the geographic market code associated with the order, used to benchmark regional sales performance and logistics coverage.
sku: Holds the stock keeping unit identifier for the ordered product, used to evaluate item-level velocity and inventory turnover.
status: Holds the current operational state of the order, used to monitor fulfillment progress, cancellation rates, and shipment exceptions.
unit_price_usd: Holds the base price per unit in US dollars, used to evaluate product pricing tiers and unit-level profitability.
warehouse: Holds the specific distribution facility handling the order, used to evaluate facility throughput, capacity utilization, and fulfillment efficiency.
